thread:
acme-poc: We're seeing a ton of 503s and timeouts since 2026-03-17 10:12 UTC on /v1/generate (streaming). SDK is retrying, client loop. Request IDs: req_20260317_101200_abc, req_20260317_101201_def, req_20260317_101210_ghi. Any idea?

ana (support): Sorry about that — can you paste a minimal repro and a request-id? Also are you using our JS SDK or direct curl?

acme-poc: JS SDK v0.9.2. Minimal curl for repro:
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-medium","input":"summarize: ...","stream":true}'
```

Examples of request-ids we saw: req_20260317_101200_abc, req_20260317_101201_def, req_20260317_101210_ghi

sam (eng-oncall): flagged. @kevin can you grab traces for those req ids and auth-service logs around 10:12? Also what's the p95/p99 for that window?

kevin (eng-infra): pulling traces now. Quick look: auth-token-service is emitting 502s to the ingress at 10:11:58–10:13:30; high KMS latency reported. Ingress started returning 502 to API gateway, causing gateway->runtime to reject streaming handshakes (503/504).

ana (support): Can we get a short mitigation? Customer is getting retries and duplicate tokens.

kevin (eng-infra): Temporary mitigations: 1) increase auth cache TTL from 30s -> 300s; 2) throttle token refresh fanout (limit parallel refreshes per tenant); 3) enable model-fallback to cpu-variant for that tenant.

chloe (customer-success): I'll message the customer about the intended temporary changes and ask for go-ahead. acme-poc any objections to a short cache TTL bump and a model fallback while we investigate?

acme-poc: Ok to try cache bump + throttle. We prefer no traffic loss.

deploy-bot: Starting rollout: config/auth-cache-ttl bump -> 300s to default cluster. Deploy id: dply-20260317-11

deploy-bot: Rollout complete for config/auth-cache-ttl (dply-20260317-11) :white_check_mark:

sam (eng-oncall): Monitoring metrics: auth service 5xxs falling, gateway 503s count down from 120/min -> 8/min within 2 mins. p95 latency improved from 1.8s -> 0.4s.

ana (support): acme-poc can you confirm on your end? Any 503s seen now?

acme-poc: Observed huge drop. From ~1 every 10s to none in the last 3 mins. Thanks. :relieved: 

kevin (eng-infra): We'll keep throttle and cache changes for 2 hours while we root-cause KMS latency. Next steps: KMS team to validate key rotation job around 10:10 that bumped latency. We'll open a follow-up RFC.

chloe (customer-success): Noting customer satisfied for now. I'll update account notes and let them know we'll follow up with RCA.

ana (support): Filing internal incident ticket INC-2026-124 and assigning to eng-sre + infra for RCA. Links: https://redwood.atl/incidents/INC-2026-124

acme-poc: Thanks the team — appreciate the quick mitigation.

sam (eng-oncall): Leaving a pointer: disable aggressive SDK retry loop if you use default retries; set maxRetries=2 and jittered backoff. We'll add guidance in our SDK docs.

ana (support): Marking thread resolved for customer contact. Will re-open if they see recurrence. :thumbsup:
